description: This file defines the TopNavAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying top navigation categories in an Android TV app. It manages focus behavior, visual feedback, and special items like a search icon within the navigation list.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter for displaying navigation categories with TV focus and custom behaviors.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for navigation items.

variables.name: SEARCH_ITEM
variables.description: Constant token used to identify the search icon item.

classes.name: TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing each navigation item's views and behaviors.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Configures the item's views based on the text, including focus behaviors and click handling.

methods.name: TopNavDiff
methods.description: DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation for efficiently updating the list.
